adguard-home.description: Block ads and tracking on every device in your network. AdGuard Home acts as a DNS server with built-in content filtering — no client-side software needed.

adguard-dnsproxy-doq.tagline: Local DNS-over-QUIC upstream proxy for VyOS PowerDNS
adguard-dnsproxy-doq.description: Runs AdGuard dnsproxy locally on VyOS so the built-in PowerDNS Recursor can forward queries to an encrypted DNS-over-QUIC upstream for deployments where PowerDNS remains the LAN DNS server.

memory.label: Memory (MB)
memory.description: dnsproxy is lightweight; increase only for unusually high query volume.

listenAddress.label: Local Listen Address
listenAddress.description: Use 127.0.0.1 when PowerDNS on VyOS will forward to this container locally.

listenPort.label: Local Listen Port
listenPort.description: Port dnsproxy listens on locally. Avoid 53 because VyOS PowerDNS normally owns LAN DNS.

bootstrap1.label: Bootstrap DNS 1
bootstrap1.description: Bootstrap resolver used to resolve the upstream hostname before encrypted DNS is established.

bootstrap2.label: Bootstrap DNS 2
bootstrap2.description: Second bootstrap resolver. Kept required because the generic wizard cannot conditionally omit arguments.

nprobe.description: ntop nProbe is a high-performance NetFlow v5/v9/IPFIX probe and collector with embedded IPS capabilities.

memory.label: Memory (MB)
memory.description: Memory limit. Increase for high-traffic environments.

nfqueue.description: Set the NF queue to use in your firewall rules

ntopng.description: ntop ntopng is a network traffic probe that shows network usage, supports NetFlow/sFlow, packet analysis, and provides a modern web interface. Ideal for deep inspection of your VyOS router traffic.

memory.label: Memory (MB)
memory.description: ntopng can use significant memory when tracking many flows.

interface.label: Network Interface
interface.description: Interface to monitor (e.g., eth0, bond0, eth1).

webPort.label: Web Interface Port
webPort.description: Port for the ntopng web UI.

pihole.description: Block ads and trackers for all devices on your network using DNS‑based filtering. Pi‑hole includes a web interface.

password.label: Admin Password
password.description: Password for the web admin interface.

webPort.label: Web Interface Port
webPort.description: Port for the Pi‑hole web UI.

nginx-proxy-manager.tagline: Reverse proxy with a beautiful UI
nginx-proxy-manager.description: Expose web services on your network with free SSL, powered by Let's Encrypt. Manage proxy hosts, redirections, and streams through a clean web interface.

technitium-dns.tagline: Feature-rich self-hosted DNS server with web console
technitium-dns.description: A fully-featured open source DNS server with a web console on port 5380. Supports DNS-over-HTTPS, DNS-over-TLS, DNSSEC, zone management, ad blocking, and query logging.

serverDomain.label: Server Domain
serverDomain.description: Primary domain name this DNS server uses to identify itself.

netbird-cloud.name: NetBird (Cloud)
netbird-cloud.tagline: Zero-config WireGuard mesh VPN — managed by NetBird Cloud
netbird-cloud.description: Join this router to your NetBird Cloud mesh as a WireGuard peer. Paste a setup key and NetBird runs the control plane for you — nothing to host.

setupKey.label: Setup Key
setupKey.description: Generate one in the NetBird dashboard under Setup Keys. Required for the agent to register unattended.

hostname.label: Peer Name
hostname.description: Name this peer shows up as in your NetBird network.

netbird-selfhosted.name: NetBird (Self-hosted)
netbird-selfhosted.tagline: WireGuard mesh VPN against your own NetBird control plane
netbird-selfhosted.description: Join this router to a NetBird mesh as a WireGuard peer, pointed at a NetBird server you host yourself. Add your management URL and a setup key.

managementUrl.label: Management URL
managementUrl.description: URL of your self-hosted NetBird Management server (include the scheme and port).

setupKey.label: Setup Key
setupKey.description: Generate one in your self-hosted NetBird dashboard under Setup Keys. Required for the agent to register unattended.

hostname.label: Peer Name
hostname.description: Name this peer shows up as in your NetBird network.

tailscale-cloud.name: Tailscale (Cloud)
tailscale-cloud.tagline: Zero-config WireGuard mesh VPN — managed by Tailscale
tailscale-cloud.description: Join this router to your Tailscale tailnet as a WireGuard peer. Paste an auth key and Tailscale runs the control plane for you — nothing to host.

authKey.label: Auth Key
authKey.description: Generate one in the Tailscale admin console under Settings → Keys. Required for the node to register unattended.

hostname.label: Machine Name
hostname.description: Name this machine shows up as in your tailnet.

advertiseRoutes.label: Advertise Routes
advertiseRoutes.description: Optional. Comma-separated subnets this router advertises to the tailnet (subnet router). Leave blank for none. Routes still need approval in the admin console.

tailscale-headscale.tagline: Tailscale client pointed at a self-hosted Headscale server
tailscale-headscale.description: Join this router to a Headscale-managed mesh as a WireGuard peer. Same Tailscale client, pointed at a Headscale server you host yourself via a login-server URL.

loginServer.label: Login Server URL
loginServer.description: URL of your self-hosted Headscale server (include the scheme).

authKey.label: Auth Key
authKey.description: A Headscale pre-auth key (headscale preauthkeys create --user <user>). Required for the node to register unattended.

hostname.label: Machine Name
hostname.description: Name this machine shows up as in your Headscale network.

advertiseRoutes.label: Advertise Routes
advertiseRoutes.description: Optional. Comma-separated subnets this router advertises (subnet router). Leave blank for none. Routes still need approval in Headscale.

speedtest.description: Run a browser-based internet speed test from your own network. OpenSpeedTest measures download, upload, latency, and jitter without requiring an app or browser plugin.

webPort.label: Web Interface Port
webPort.description: Port for the OpenSpeedTest web interface.
